_: Resource-node kinds (2.9b-a, standard 18): one row per ingredient the slice's ecology grows. A row names its socket-vocabulary plantClasses row, which holds the species and regrowDays; worldgen.crafting_records validates and writes packages/crafting/src/data/resource-nodes.json (stationClass = the first species, respawnHours = regrowDays x 24). A placed node is a placed piece of one of the species (decision 0070; a layout `place` op binds {use: gather, nodeId}).
